name: xxd-panel-112

tagline_en: From snapshot to handmade-paper art: two layers, narrow color fields, matte crayon lines, restrained gold.
desc_en: Create XXD Panel 112 raster artwork by translating a source photograph into a quiet two-layer handmade-paper collage with a narrow irregular colour field, deep matte crayon lines, restrained gold accents, Risograph grain, and generous whitespace.
